display_information.name: HPP Message Bot
display_information.description: Daily High Performance Planning check-ins that fill in your own Google Doc
display_information.long_description: Each morning HPP Message Bot asks your High Performance Planning questions one at a time, then creates High Performance Planning YYYY-MM-DD in your Google Drive. During the day, check off tasks from the Home tab; at night, score your daily review. Only people who sign up get messages, and you can pause or leave any time.

slash_commands.description: Plan today, update tasks, or score your day
